_comment: EXAMPLE routine showing the bridge in action: every step's tool calls target the 'ai4ia-toolbox' toolbox, which is fronted by the official-MCP APIM, so the routine inherits that governance with no new APIM surface. Copy/edit this file and run scripts/provision-foundry-routine.py --create (needs the 'foundry' dependency group + a live project). Nothing here is consumed by the app runtime or the deploy. Preview.
name: research-brief
description: Two-step research brief: gather grounded sources, then synthesize a cited summary. All tool calls route through the APIM-fronted toolbox.

steps.name: gather
steps.instructions: Use web_search and azure_ai_search to collect authoritative sources for the user's question. Prefer primary and recent sources; record every URL.

steps.name: synthesize
steps.instructions: Write a concise brief that answers the question. Follow the citation-discipline skill: every claim must cite one of the gathered sources.
